caption:
One verse to renew your intention this Friday

Allah tells the Prophet ﷺ to say that his prayer, his sacrifice, his living and his dying are all for Allah, Lord of the worlds, who has no partner. Carry that intention into everything you do today.

Surah Al-An'aam 6:162-163

Say this verse to yourself before you leave the house today

#intention #niyyah #fridayreminder #quranreels

Recitation: Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary
alt_text: Say, “Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are all for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. This is what I have been commanded, and I am the first to submit to Allah.” (Surah Al-An'aam 6:162-163)
